           PLATANUS OCCIDENTALIS

         Sycamore-Buttonwood


Tarsal tumors  . Apply the tincture. Both acute and old
        neglected cases, where destruction of tissue occurred and cicatricial contraction caused
        marked deformity of lid, restored to practically normal conditions. Acts best in children.
        Must be used for some time. Ichtyosis.
